The Moselle wine appellation occupies an area between St.-Remy-sur-Argens, Bouchain, Lunéville and Mirecourt (near Trier, Germany). The Moselle appellation produces an abundance of whites, dry rosés, red wines made from both Pinot Blanc (or Auxerrois or Blé), Riesling or Gewürztraminer, Meunier (a cross between Pinot Noir and Chardonnay), and Gamay (aka Côt).
